name: LibreNMS-Dispatcher
description: Dispatcher service sidecar for an existing LibreNMS container (for example librenms from A75G's repository). The official LibreNMS image does not poll devices on its own: polling and discovery run in at least one separate dispatcher container. This template runs that container from the same official image librenms/librenms with SIDECAR_DISPATCHER=1. Use the same appdata folder (/data) and the same database settings as your LibreNMS container, and start LibreNMS first. Redis is required (the dispatcher does not start without it), for example the Redis app from Community Apps. With several dispatchers, give each a unique DISPATCHER_NODE_ID and hostname. Check the result in LibreNMS under Settings - Pollers: the dispatcher shows up with its node ID and hostname.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: The SAME folder your LibreNMS container uses for /data (config, RRD files, logs).

variables.name: DB_HOST
variables.description: Database host or IP, as in your LibreNMS container. It must be reachable from this container's network.

variables.name: DB_NAME
variables.description: Database name, as in your LibreNMS container.

variables.name: DB_USER
variables.description: Database user, as in your LibreNMS container.

variables.name: DB_PASSWORD
variables.description: Database password, as in your LibreNMS container.

variables.name: DB_TIMEOUT
variables.description: Seconds to wait for the database at start.

variables.name: DISPATCHER_NODE_ID
variables.description: Unique ID of this dispatcher. Use a different one for each dispatcher container.

variables.name: REDIS_HOST
variables.description: Redis host or IP. Required: the dispatcher does not start without Redis. Set the same Redis on the LibreNMS container.

variables.name: DISPATCHER_ARGS
variables.description: Extra arguments for librenms-service.py, e.g. -v for verbose logs.

variables.name: MEMORY_LIMIT
variables.description: PHP memory limit for the poller processes.

variables.name: SIDECAR_DISPATCHER
variables.description: Runs this container as dispatcher. Must stay 1.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID, same as in your LibreNMS container.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID, same as in your LibreNMS container.
